text_differences: Princeton normalizes long-s and typography. The report uses the editorial English label Judge; this release does not claim diplomatic transcription of the historical typography.

source_collation.historical_diagrams: Original p6–7 diagrams inspected as collation context; dash/star alignment is not adopted as an independently certified complete chart fixture. Bennett published dot-chart is the 15-position reference; further original diagram collation remains P1.
source_collation.excluded: Triplicities, signs, planets, house meanings and alternative astrological procedure not executable.

alias_policy: Exact canonical ID, Latin label or listed alias; case-insensitive casefold only, no trimming, fuzzy match or universal traditional renaming. Raw request retained. Patterns are four top-to-bottom 1/2 digits.

construction.representation: Four displayed dot counts 1=single/odd and 2=double/even; string or four integer array accepted for each input pattern.
construction.binary: No external integer/bit representation. Internal figures and reports use displayed dot counts only.
construction.mothers: Four independently entered ordered figures; repeated patterns allowed.
construction.daughters: Daughter j takes row j of Mothers 1 through 4 in that exact order.
construction.logical_order: M1..M4,D1..D4,N1..N4,W1,W2,Judge; positions 1..15. Display can reverse each tier only; it cannot change logical data or arithmetic.
construction.display_effect: Reverse each tier for display only; never reverse logical Mothers or renumber source parents.
construction.historical_vs_editorial: Turner common arithmetic and p3 identities; shield display is explicitly editorial and Bennett-style right-to-left by default. Original p7 house sentence says left-to-right; no house projection is performed.

shield_modes.patterns: Exactly four four-row 1/2 patterns in mothers
shield_modes.mark_counts: Exactly sixteen integers in mark_counts, 1–1000000, Mother-major then top-to-bottom; raw counts and derived parities retained
shield_modes.figure_ids: Exactly four exact named-table identifiers/names/listed aliases in figure_ids

input_contract.catalog: All sixteen identities or lookup list of 1–16 exact aliases/IDs/patterns; no shield inputs allowed.
input_contract.validation: Strict object fields/schema/types; booleans/floats/nonpositive counts, mixed modes, bad rows, unknown names/conventions, duplicate JSON keys/nonfinite values rejected with exit2 JSON/Markdown. Raw Unicode and whitespace preserved.
input_contract.seeded: Unsupported; no RNG calls, domains or inherited protocols changed.

reports.positions: Source/profile identities, names/patterns/rows, parent indices, transposition and line parity traces; mark-count conversion trace where applicable.
reports.replay: Complete validated raw request; source exact-file SHA256, canonical profile/request SHA256. Canonical UTF8 sorted-key compact JSON, unescaped Unicode, no trailing LF; field whitespace retained. No network, implicit location/time, generated observations or RNG.

evidence_layers.direct: Source-located historical figure identities and construction procedure
evidence_layers.compositional: Traceable numerical construction, no inferred forecast or good/bad score
evidence_layers.user_attributed: Raw voluntary question/comments/associations, explicit counts/patterns and declared origin
evidence_layers.unsupported: Factual prediction, diagnosis, supernatural accuracy and positive/negative horary certification

independent.reference: scripts/geomancy_reference.py; independent top-bit-first 1=single/0=double bit matrix and XOR; no future imports

verification.tests_run: Full unittest suite; all 31 CLI smoke modules; all 15 inherited symbolic verifiers plus Geomancy; source registry; dependency audit; pip check; whole-pass diff check
verification.scope: Independent source/known-answer and exhaustive mathematical checks; no empirical divination validation
